newsitem.title: SPAIN: Retail offer for Repsol expanded.
newsitem.headline: Retail offer for Repsol expanded.

text.p: The retail share offer for Spanish energy group Repsol was expanded by 2,550,243 shares at the expense of the institutional tranche, state holding group SEPI said.
The expanded retail tranche is now 15,301,455 shares, or 60 percent of the entire offer.
"SEPI has taken this decision because of the very strong demand from individual investors," SEPI said in a statement.
SEPI said demand for the retail tranche was 45 times the initial offer size.
The government is selling its last 10 percent stake in the energy blue chip this month. The price of the offer will be set on Monday after the close of the New York Stock Exchange.
SEPI said it will also make available final details of retail and institutional demand. The institutional tranche is at present nine times oversubscribed, it said. --Madrid Newsroom +34 1 585 2167
